name: Saionji Kai
source: Saoinji is class president and student of protag. As would you expect he is hard working, strict, dutiful for class president. Born in a rich prestigious family he was pushed to be successful. Despite being forced to cross dress by rigid vote he still agrees to do it because sees it as his duty.
